site.name: NexFlow
site.description: Declarative, GitOps-driven cloud foundations for Azure and AWS. We build the workflows so your engineers can focus on code.

values.title: Zero Manual Drift
values.problem: Click-ops in the portal leads to inconsistent environments and security holes.
values.solution: 100% Declarative IaC. If it isn't in Git, it doesn't exist in production.

values.title: Developer Autonomy
values.problem: Engineers waiting weeks for ticket-based infrastructure provisioning.
values.solution: Self-service modules that allow teams to spin up compliant stacks in minutes.

values.title: Cost Observability
values.problem: Surprise cloud bills and 'zombie' resources running in dev environments.
values.solution: Automated tagging and lifecycle policies that prune unused resources and track every cent.

services.title: Kubernetes Foundations
services.desc: Production-grade AKS and EKS clusters provisioned via Terraform with built-in observability, zero-trust networking, and auto-scaling.

services.title: Workflow Logic
services.desc: Integrate n8n, Logic Apps, and Zapier to automate deployment triggers and operational tasks.

services.title: Pure GitOps
services.desc: ArgoCD and Flux implementation. Git is your single source of truth—no manual changes, ever.

services.title: API-First Integration
services.desc: Custom middleware and API connectors to link your legacy systems with modern cloud workflows.
